request-prompt: Remove the scopebar navigation links, site favicons, and metadata strings beneath search results, presenting only plain text titles and clean URLs on a distraction-free white background.
goal: I prefer a highly minimalist and uncluttered search interface that focuses strictly on the text results without extra visual noise.
jobs: I want to navigate to the official Microsoft website to browse and learn about their products.
I want to log in to my Microsoft, Office 365, or Outlook account to access my emails and files.
I want to find customer support or troubleshooting guides for a Microsoft product.
I want to read background information, facts, or history about Microsoft on Wikipedia.
I want to filter these search results to specifically view images, videos, maps, or news about Microsoft.
I want to ask Copilot a follow-up question to get AI-generated information about Microsoft.
I want to perform a completely new search by typing in the search box.
I want to check or manage my Microsoft Rewards points.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer to find information by scanning traditional, reliable blue links and exploring websites myself.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer using AI-powered chat systems and summaries to directly answer my questions without needing to click through websites.
